text:
nina: FYI noticed weird quota drift after the go client 0.9.0 release. Some tenants show large spike in 'unattributed' requests in console. anyone else seeing it? :confused:

rob: saw it too, looks like the route-hint header payload changed shape.

jin: which header? example?

nina: old behavior from clients sent:
```http
X-Route-Hint: tenant=acme;policy=low-latency;quota=team-blue
```
New go client sends compressed form (to save bytes):
```http
X-Route-Hint: acme|low-latency|team-blue
```

omar: ah that breaks the console parser which expects key=val pairs. our telemetry pipeline treats unknown shapes as "unattributed".

rob: why did the go client switch? Was this an intentional change in 0.9.0?

jin: it was an intentional micro-optimization from PR #5128 to reduce header overhead for high QPS clients. but we missed updating the console/proxy contract. my bad.

nina: impact: quota dashboards undercount attributed usage for affected tenants ~25-40%. Bad for billing and spike alerts.

eng-proxy-bot: note: rolling back proxy header normalization is possible but will increase header parsing CPU.

omar: proposed path: short-term proxy shim to expand compressed form back into key=val pairs; medium-term: update console ingest to accept both shapes; long-term: formalize header contract in spec and add SDK compatibility tests.

rob: agree. Also we should add a feature flag in go client to toggle "compact-route-hint" off per-tenant until console is fully compatible.

jin: can add flag ROH_COMPACT=true by default in 0.9.x and plan 0.10.0 to flip off after rollout. we'll document it.

nina: who's owning the proxy shim? omar?

omar: I can land a canary shim today in edge-proxy. Will add unit tests and an end-to-end replay for sample tenant.

rob: add an observability guard: alert if attributed usage drops by >15% for a tenant for 10m during the shim rollout.

eng-proxy-bot: deploy queued: expand-route-hint-shim -> staging (omar)

omar: staging canary up. running synthetic traffic. initial numbers look promising; attribution recovers.

jin: I'll cut a patch release 0.9.1 with opt-out flag and note in changelog.

nina: also put a short message in console release notes + support playbook steps for customers who hit this.

rob: let's add a tiny integration test in ci-infra: spin up proxy + console ingest and verify both header shapes map to same quota_bucket. prevents regressions.

omar: filed GH issues: #6210 (proxy shim), #6211 (console ingest), #6212 (sdk flag + docs).

jin: thanks. timeline: shim -> prod canary tomorrow, 0.9.1 today, console patch next week.

nina: followups: update rollout doc, add postmortem if any tenant billing affected, and schedule a short sync with billing/support.

rob: thanks all. small P0 but glad we caught it quickly. :+1:
